children: Credit default swaps have widened for Oracle
and other hyperscalers and major technology and aerospace peers, including Google

credit default swaps spiked to record highs on Thursday, signaling heightened investor concerns over the AI hyperscaler’s debt. Its 5-year CDS spread rose 16.2% from the prior week across both bid and ask quotes, reaching a record 227.15 bps.

Oracle has also issued a force majeure notice to the developer of its massive “Project Jupiter” data center in New Mexico, adding to concerns around the company’s rapidly expanding AI infrastructure commitments.
Treasury yields surged, with the 30-year yield climbing to its highest level since 2004 and the 10-year yield hitting a fresh 19-year high, adding to pressure across corporate credit markets.

title: Hyperscaler CDS spreads widen, with Oracle hitting record high
